items.html: But she has an impression (Reshimu) from the aspect of face to face, and she can stand with him face to face then, in the secret of the Tefillin. And the rest of the aforementioned nine, we raise them little by little from BYA until the blessing of the Patriarchs. And then, at the recitation of the Shema, the six extremities of Gadlut enter ZA; and these nine of hers also begin to ascend up to the ZA of Atzilut. Then Malchut ascends, and that point returns to the back.
